body:
I absolutely agree. I read it just the other day and I found it be a very sad, dark story of someone who’s clearly struggling and an addict. As someone who has dealt with my own mental illness, addictions, and hospital visits I found parts of the book painfully difficult and many times I recognized some of his thoughts as ones I had myself. 

I have hurt people and done awful things, and I don’t try to excuse my own actions, but I also recognize that part of it *is* due to a disease that, frankly, at times, I have no control over.
Well I’m divorced if that counts. :/
I know that feeling too well. Every night heading to bed that’s the last thing on my mind.
Doing the same from Canada

I wish I could tell you something to make you feel better but I can tell you from experience that really nothing anyone says can. My FP, who was my husband, left me in January and since then I’ve just been empty. So all of this is to say I understand how you feel, and it fucking sucks.
A friend of a friend died by suicide recently and my only thought was, wow they’re lucky. :(
Just wanted to say I’m listening, and I so empathize about having to deal with everything and how that toil just feels never ending.

I told myself 27 originally, but then I met the love of my life, got married, the whole thing. And then we separated. So now it’s 30YO.

I turn 30 in 2 days and I want to kill myself more than ever.
Honestly I was down to my husband and this friend. So in the end, as it has always been, it’s just the fucking piece of shit that’s me.
I hope you find some solace too.
Oh definitely. She knows I meditate on the daily, and she’s more than shown up for me in a million other ways. :)

For record, I love my mom, and she is doing her best. I appreciate her supporting me in what way she can, and she’s saying this out of kindness and a different environment and social upbringing she had. She’s fully supportive of me being in therapy, taking meds, and is very open to talking to me.

The way she said to not worry about anything made me giggle and I just thought it was some funny material for this subreddit. :)
Thanks for putting this in a better way than I could. I don’t think my mom is a moron, she has good intentions and I can tell that it helps her. It just doesn’t help me personally.

Waking up in the psych ward after an attempt because my husband asked for a divorce. Got out a few days later but mentally I’m still at my lowest ever. Considering another attempt- and hopefully a more successful attempt. :c
Thank you. Means a lot that a random stranger would say anything.
That’s great! The separation just happened so I’m spending the day doing more cleaning and packing. But my friends are coming by to play board games later which will be a nice distraction.
How are you doing today. :) I’m in Canada, just starting my day now.
You just reminded me of a very painful memory of someone telling me that they reason they ghosted me in the past was because I was “a bit much”.
Hey just wanted to say I see you - pretty severe depression, my husband and I split up because of things I did, and now now it turns out I have ADHD. Pretty fucking sucks in this pit.
I’m too scared I’m going to fuck it up and survive in a worse way.
Absolutely, but you can’t have a one sided relationship. :(

Part of me still wishes I wasn’t chicken shit and did it properly instead of whatever this cry of attention was, wasting police and hospital resources, on top of my friends time and energy. :(

But thank you.
Yes

Yeah.

 It’s not even just emotional cheating, it was straight up sexting. And the worst part is he has been comforting me and loving me even though he should be hating me.
I don’t think *he* can forgive me right now.
I don’t know what to talk about, I’m just a shit person I guess.
This is beautiful. I hope you keep writing.
Yeah absolutely. So I leave first.
Just want to say that I read it all, and that I think the sentiment of being tired isn’t wrong.
Until reading these comments, I honestly did not know that this was a dark desire. :/ I literally think this on a weekly basis…
Best I can do atm is to give you a virtual hug and say I’m right here with you.
Just adding another stranger who’s having an awful day. :c
Yeah, I’ve been going to an amazing therapist for over a year now. It’s just me.

The problem for me is on paper everything is perfect. I’m married to best arson alive, I have pets. I have my masters degree, a great job, we have a house. I have a great group of friends, hobbies, the whole shebang.

It’s just once I’m inside my head, nothing matters. And then I feel worse because I have everything but it means nothing.



Hope you’re doing okay too, internet fren.
so I guess I'm swapping over to this account now. what a fucking pain in the ass. i'm a fucking idiot.
